line_label: Aricept (East Asia Global South - revenue from major products)
revenue_scope: Aricept revenue in Eisai's East Asia Global South (EAGS) segment, Eisai-recorded
geography: East Asia Global South (primarily South Korea, Taiwan, India, ASEAN, Central and South America, South Africa)
why_separate: The gold series is Eisai's global Aricept brand total (with Japan, China and Asia sub-rows). From the FY2026 Q1 Reference Data the global total is no longer printed; Aricept survives only as regional lines in the segment tables, here EAGS, which is one piece of the former total.
notes: Narrower line: one piece of the former brand total. The same document prints a second piece, Aricept in China, JPY 2.9 billion for FY2026 Q1 (FY2025 Q1 2.4, full year 8.8; page 7), which is not used because only one line can be carried; it is recorded here only. Aricept in Japan is not printed in the Japan prescription medicines major-products list of this document, and no global Aricept total appears anywhere in it. The document's 'Revenue from Major Products' and 'Changes in Quarterly Revenue from Major Products' tables list only Lenvima, Leqembi and Dayvigo ('Major Products (3L)'). EAGS full-year Aricept for FY2025 is 14.6 in both this document and the FY2025 Q4 document (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/45230/140120260514534240.pdf), so the line is consistent with the earlier regional table. Only one quarter (2026Q2) falls after the series end.
